subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should ordinary agent `write` expose append as `append?: boolean`, a string `mode`, or a separate append tool?
rationale: The data-loss need is well supported, but the permanent model-facing tool contract and backend `WriteOperations` surface are maintainer-owned API/product decisions.

options.title: Accept `append?: boolean` on `write`
options.body: Approve the smallest default-preserving extension implemented here and land after exact-head checks and owner review remain clean.

options.title: Request a `mode` field
options.body: Ask the PR to replace the boolean with a string mode if maintainers want a more extensible write contract before merge.

options.title: Use a dedicated append tool
options.body: Keep `write` overwrite-only and require a separate model-facing append tool if maintainers want strict operation separation.

recommendation.title: Accept `append?: boolean` on `write`
recommendation.body: Approve the smallest default-preserving extension implemented here and land after exact-head checks and owner review remain clean.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points to steipete as the closest available owner for agent runtime and product/API boundary decisions on this surface.
